author: Pegasus

checks.name: Source registration defaults to observation; metadata is firm-only and contains no keys
Forged asset and reporter receive HTTP 403 and create no incident
Observation-only source cannot trigger holds/actions; requested and effective assessments are recorded privately
Two sources with the same external ID get independent receipts in the same global episode
Rotation invalidates the old key while preserving source identity and exact-ID deduplication
Burst receives HTTP 429 with retry timing while another source continues; no holds or deadline extensions
Revocation returns HTTP 401 even for built-in demo IDs; no authorization fallback
Confirm-capable source without evidence remains notify-only
Scoped confirmed source automatically changes owned target access 200→403; unrelated access stays 200

evidence.boundary: Owned sandbox only; includes network/scheduling time, not a production benchmark.

checks.name: Authorized Undo restores access; replay does not repeat the action and historical verification remains
Every created detector is revoked and its credential receives HTTP 401 after cleanup

scope: Synthetic data on owned DEV; actual detector HTTP/auth/Convex execution and owned sandbox checks. No external detector integration or live identity-provider action.
unchanged: No reset, deploy, environment-flag change, real payment or chatbot operation.
